title: prunus × lannesiana f. ohsibayama
intro: Prunus × lannesiana f. ohsibayama, commonly known as the Japanese apricot, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Prunus × lannesiana f. ohsibayama include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and anti-microbial properties.
